title: Expression
says: A way of looking at the field, held as a holon: an expression that gathers holons, so it can be given to a mount, shown by its words, or looked through to what it gathers.

title.says: What the way of looking is called.

gathers.says: The expression itself: what it gathers from the field.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.
